evidence: Official LangSAM probe across7 calibrated views: white industrial machine housing selected factory structures; white machine base isolated the intended lower housing in close views but selected adjacent devices in other views.
instance_selection: Project the reviewed fixed physical target's 3D box into each camera. Rank unmodified LangSAM candidate masks by binary cosine overlap with the projected region; accept score>=0.25, otherwise use empty mask. The ROI does not create or crop the selected semantic mask.
applies_to: EditSplat SAM mask for background replacement
limitations: A common instance-disambiguation adaptation is required for the repeated industrial devices. Results must be described as official algorithms with this explicit scene adapter, not pristine unmodified repository runs.

semantic_tracing_threshold.reason: High0.8 threshold rejected most target Gaussians due repeated-device views/occlusions; use GE and DreamCatalyst generic default0.5 for the common scene. DGE changes from its yaml0.8. Five diagnostic view coverage84.4-87.8%.
